data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mary total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.

tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Miriam. Standard interpretations give 'beloved' or 'rebellious'; a popular alternative links it to mara, 'bitter'. Its root is Hebrew m-r-y-m. Mary, the mother of Jesus (Luke 1:26-38). Mary is a Hebrew name meaning “Beloved; (also) bitter; rebellious”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
